newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: United Engineers reorganises health units.
newsitem.headline: United Engineers reorganises health units.

text.p: United Engineering Ltd said on Tuesday it had reorganised its healthcare operations.

Under the reorganisation, its wholly-owned unit Medical Hall Ltd had been renamed United MediCorp Pte Ltd and would hold all the shares in the group's six healthcare units, which were formerly held by various units, a company statement said.
As part of the changes, United MediCorp Pte Ltd had increased its authorised share capital to 50 million shares of Singapore $1.00 each from 200,000 of S$1.00 each.
It said the internal restructuring would have no significant impact on the group's net tangible assets per share for the financial year ending December 31, 1996.
